headline: Lola Young 🫁 Says VAPING 🍃 Made BREATHING 😮‍💨 a CHORE 🧹
text:
MESSY 🎤 singer Lola Young just DROPPED 💥 a TikTok 🍿 where she ADMITS 😔 her LUNGS 🫁 feel like they're straight up BATTERY 🔋 POWERED ⚡ after months of VAPING 🍃 turning every BREATH 💨 into a literal CHORE 🧹!! The 25-year-old GRAMMY 🏆 winner who took FIVE-MONTH 🗓️ hiatus after COLLAPSING 🥴 on stage is now back but her RESPIRATORY 🍃 game is COOKED 🔥!! She says breathing feels like HARD 💪 WORK 🛠️ like she should get PAID 💰 just to inhale and that there might be NO 🚫 TOMORROW 🌅!! Vocal coach Lizzii Hills hit up BBC 📺 to say vaping is NOT ADVISED 🚫 for artists because it messes with the LUNGS 🫁 AIRWAYS 🌀 and THROAT 😮 all connected so your VOCAL 🎤 TECHNIQUE gets RAILED 💦!!

Lola Young told her followers her LUNGS 🫁 are basically running on one BIG 🔋 BATTERY and that the day has COME ⏰ after she once rolled her EYES 🙄 at warnings saying NAH 🚫!! Royal College of Paediatrics reviewed over EIGHTY 📊 studies linking VAPING 🍃 to WHEEZING 😮‍💨 COUGHING 🤧 poor SLEEP 😴 MENTAL 🧠 issues and even EYE 👁️ problems bro!! The NHS 🏥 says it's less harmful than SMOKING 🚬 but risks are still UNKNOWN ❓ with government now SLAPPING 💥 a new TAX 💰 on e-liquid adding TWO POUNDS TWENTY 💷 per TEN ML 🧪 plus the BAN 🚫 on single-use vapes from last year!! Lola who won GRAMMY 🏆 for her hit Messy earlier this year has been open about her past COCAINE 🥥 dependency mental health struggles and schizoaffective disorder but this VAPE 🫠 situation got her breathing feeling like she should CLOCK IN ⏰ for every inhale!!

Vocal coach Lizzii Hills explained that when your LUNGS 🫁 get hit by VAPING 🍃 it affects the entire RESPIRATORY 🌀 chain so singers end up TRYING HARDER 💪 for the same NOTES 🎵 they used to hit easy!! She says breathing is KEY 🔑 for controlled INHALATION 🌬️ and sustained EXHALATION 💨 otherwise your VOCAL 🎤 technique gets strained and you risk LOSING 🥲 yourself emotionally!! Hills wouldn't recommend VAPING 🍃 to any clients because as a PERFORMER 🎤 you gotta stay in PEAK 🏔️ health for your voice to SLAY 💅 at its best!! Lola Young returned to the STAGE 🎤 this year after working on herself following that scary COLLAPSE 🫠 and now she's warning everyone that the VAPE 🫠 effects finally caught up just like that one person predicted when she was younger and she said NAH 🚫 but here we are!!

The Messy singer straight up quoted that someone told her there would be a DAY 📅 at 25 or 26 when she'd wake from DEEP 😴 sleep and feel the VAPING 🍃 consequences but she rolled her EYES 🙄 and now it's HERE 🏠!! Her lungs feel like they're BATTERY 🔋 POWERED ⚡ and breathing is such a CHORE 🧹 it feels like HARD LABOR ⛏️ with no tomorrow in sight!! BBC contacted her reps for COMMENT 🗣️ but this TikTok post has everyone talking about how even GRAMMY 🏆 winners aren't immune to the respiratory DRAMA 🎭 vaping brings!! Coach Hills added that struggling with your VOICE 🎤 can mess with your head big time making artists feel like they've LOST 🥲 their whole identity which hits different when you're already dealing with ADHD and other battles like Lola has been!!

Government measures are coming in hot with the single-use VAPE 🫠 ban already LIVE ✅ and that fresh TAX 💰 on liquids hitting this week to make them less ATTRACTIVE 😏 overall!! Lola Young has been RAW 📣 about her health journey including addiction and mental health diagnoses from her TEENAGE 🧒 years yet this latest confession about breathing feeling like WORK 🛠️ has fans WORRIED 😟!! The review of EIGHTY 📈 studies confirms higher rates of breathing problems wheezing coughing and even poor ORAL 🦷 health from vaping so maybe it's time for everyone especially ARTISTS 🎤 to listen up before their LUNGS 🫁 start running on literal BATTERIES 🔋!! Hills finished by saying if you can AVOID 🚫 it absolutely do because your voice and PERFORMANCE 🎭 depend on staying HEALTHY 🌿 at all costs!!
